label: ILLUSTRATIVE - author-written outputs, NOT produced by any model. Each shows one failure type so the scorer and stop rule have something to catch.

what_each_shows.R02: referee phone and email left in (leak a pattern check catches)
what_each_shows.R03: first name left in prose (leak only the known-name check catches) plus an unrelated edit: 30% became 40%
what_each_shows.R05: spelled-out email left in (silent leak: no check fires)
what_each_shows.R07: correct, but the reference number trips the phone pattern (false hold)
